messages:
Noah: Heads-up: heavy downpour around 7th & Brannan, bus stop is basically a shallow pond. Saw someone use a pizza box as a shield.
Priya: Pizza box strategy = peak resourcefulness. If anyone needs a dry seat, I9m in a blue Subaru bumping the 7th St curb at 8:05.
Sam: I9m two blocks away and happy to trade a coffee for a lift. Also the 22 bus is diverting because of water on 7th.
transit-bot: MUNI alert: Route 22 detoured between Mission and Brannan due to street flooding. Allow +15-30 mins.
Maya: Small miracle: front desk has a roll of heavy-duty drying paper towels and a stash of plastic bags for shoes. Help yourselves.
Priya: Bringing spare umbrellas to the lobby in 5. If you9re near Brannan and need one, text me. No charge, just good karma.
Noah: Someone left a tiny rubber duck on the curb by the bus stop. Placed it on the bench with a sticky note: "Float safe". :duck: :joy:
Sam: Also saw a commuter wearing two umbrellas like a hat-cape. Fashion or desperation? You decide.
front-desk: Note: commuter lockers available for soggy gear today. Please label items. Also, a volunteer towel basket in reception.
Maya: Pro-tip for bikers: avoid the bike lane on 7th, huge sheet of water at the corner. Take the parallel service road.
Priya: Pickup update: picked up Sam and Noah, left two umbrellas in the lobby box. If anyone needs a ride from near Brannan, I9m driving back after 9:30.
transit-bot: Caltrain advisory: minor delays inbound due to signals in the peninsula; may add +10-20m for those connecting to buses.
Noah: Commute status: soaked shoes, dry spirits, saved by eager umbrella donors. Coffee to anyone who wants to swap soggy socks for a warm cup.
Sam: Coffee accepted  thank you drivers and umbrella librarians.
Maya: Suggestion for facilities: umbrella library + small shoe dryer in the bike room? Vote with reactions.
Priya: Vote cast. Also leaving an extra granola bar in reception labeled "commute champion".
Noah: Real life heroics > calendar pings. Stay safe everyone.
